description: Fixed 90/5/5 parameter-space split for the 2500-run VPIC dataset. Training uses 2250 run names; validation is monitoring-only and is not used for checkpoint selection; test is reserved for final evaluation and visualization with the final checkpoint.

split_policy.validation_role: training-time monitoring only; no checkpoint selection or early stopping
split_policy.test_role: final-checkpoint-only quantitative evaluation and qualitative visualization
notes: The 250 held-out parameter combinations are exactly balanced across each 1D parameter marginal.
Validation and test are interleaved and balanced as evenly as possible across beta and nu, and exactly balanced across Bz0 and tau.
The two T<24 runs are assigned to train; with a 24-frame model they produce zero usable windows.
